definitions.content: fault exceeding the absolute value of the appropriate maximum permissible error for a load equal to the minimum totalized load, Sigma_min, for the designated class of the belt weigher

notes.content: A significant fault does not include faults arising from simultaneous and mutually independent causes in the belt weigher, faults implying the impossibility to perform any weighing, transitory faults, momentary variations in the indications which cannot be interpreted, memorized or transmitted as a weighing result, faults which are so serious that they will inevitably be noticed by all those interested in the weighing result.
